postalt.title: Run postalt
postalt.description: Run alt-aware postalt (postalt_rs) on the alignment. Off writes a plain BAM conversion, for the comparison baseline.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: Comma-separated sample names to convert; empty converts every alignment in the dataset.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Optional S3 URI of one CRAM or BAM with its index beside it; used instead of the dataset's file listing.
